set_seed: set the world seed in a Cuberite server config file to a specific value
add_plugin: add a plugin entry to the Plugins section of a Cuberite config file
remove_plugin: remove a plugin entry from the Plugins section of a Cuberite config file
set_mode_survival: set the game mode to survival in a Cuberite server config file
set_port: set the server port number in a Cuberite config file
